# Zod v4 Source Map

> This reference maps the public Zod v4 surface back to the source at `912f0f51b0ced654d0069741e7160834dca742ee`. It is for maintainers and users who want to see where common validators, parse helpers, codecs, JSON Schema helpers, and error formatters live in the repository.

## Zod v4

- [Zod v4 Source Map](/zod-v4/overview.html): This reference maps the public Zod v4 surface back to the source at `912f0f51b0ced654d0069741e7160834dca742ee`. It is for maintainers and users who want to see where common validators, parse helpers, codecs, JSON Schema helpers, and error formatters live in the repository.
- [Schema Constructors](/zod-v4/schema-constructors.html): Zod's most visible API is the set of schema constructors exposed from `packages/zod/src/v4/classic/schemas.ts`. These functions return concrete schema instances and usually share a nearby `Zod...` constructor implementation.
- [String And Network Formats](/zod-v4/string-and-network-formats.html): String formats are first-class constructors in the classic schema file. The format constructors return specialized string schemas rather than ad hoc refinements, which keeps JSON Schema conversion and error reporting more structured.
- [Parsing And Codecs](/zod-v4/parsing-and-codecs.html): The parse helpers are exported from `classic/parse.ts`, while schema instance methods are installed through `ZodType` in `classic/schemas.ts`. Treat the top-level helpers as convenient functional equivalents when a schema value is already in hand.
- [Composition And Transforms](/zod-v4/composition-and-transforms.html): Wrappers and composition helpers are concentrated in `classic/schemas.ts`. These APIs let a schema preserve source-level evidence while changing optionality, output shape, defaults, or control flow.
- [JSON Schema And Errors](/zod-v4/json-schema-and-errors.html): Zod v4 exports JSON Schema conversion and several error projections through the classic external entrypoint. These are useful when Zod sits between runtime validation, documentation, and API contracts.
